newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Cifra upgraded by Caspian.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Cifra upgraded by Caspian.

text.p: -- Caspian upgraded Mexican retailer Cifra SA de CV to trading buy from market performer.

--Cifra announced the termination of the company's over-funded pension plan as of June 1997 and the payment of an extraordinary 0.25 pesos per share dividend, a 2.1 percent yield, as well as a stock dividend of 12 percent to current shareholders, Caspian said.
--Caspian anaylsts Damien Fraser and Esteban Galindez said they expected the plan to be confirmed at a shareholders meeting on March 6.

--"If that is the case, we expect expect Cifra's stock price to rise on Wednesday, although not by the full 14.1 percent (12 percent plus the 2.1 percent cash dividend) as the post-dividend Cifra will have a lower market capitalization than the pre-dividend Cifra," the analysts wrote.
--Cifra was trading up 50 centavos to 12.42 pesos near midday Wednesday.

--Under the agreement, the company will buy back from the pension fund 348,731,492 series A shares, 10.9 percent of current shares outstanding, and 12 percent of reduced number of shares, Caspian said. The resources for the operation will be taken from the company's pension plan assets, bearing in mind that the pension plan is currently over-funded, Caspian said.
